title: Budget Efficiency Ratios
scenario: For each genre, find games that have a higher critic_score per million of budget than the genre average.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR), developers (game_id INT, budget NUMERIC), ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC)
hint: Calculate efficiency (critic_score / (budget/1e6)), then use AVG() OVER(PARTITION BY genre).
correctQuery: SELECT game_id FROM (SELECT g.game_id, (r.critic_score / (d.budget / 1000000.0)) as efficiency, AVG(r.critic_score / (d.budget / 1000000.0)) OVER(PARTITION BY g.genre) as avg_eff FROM games g JOIN developers d ON g.game_id = d.game_id JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id) t WHERE efficiency > avg_eff;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE developers (game_id INT, budget NUMERIC); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC);
